title: Kings Escape 40 Fridge/Freezer + Cover Bundle $179 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ 4WD Supacentre
body:
Deal: Kings Escape 40 Fridge/Freezer + Cover Bundle $179 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ 4WD Supacentre

[Two50rr] Been using this for about a month now at home for a drinks fridge/esky and its been good.
Got it with the ac adaptor and cover for $199.
On 24/7 set at 0⁰ indoors. icy cold drinks. Will see if I need the 2yr warranty….
[krisspy] 50L also on sale for the same price. No cover though
[Minimum-Chips] Thanks @krisspy
I bought the 40 without a cover, grabbed later one after a road-trip and recommend bundling one-in.
[Slippery Fish] Kings basic fridge always get the cover if Ur in warm area. In Qld if went from struggling and draining the battery attached in half a day to working and lasting all day
Also if U need 240v cord anaconda ones are usually half price quote often and it's the same cord for the dune etc.
[takemymoney] The 50l bundle need to be 30 kangaroo less to be a deal - this is good but too small for anything beyond a weekend away and getting on the beers
[godofpizza] i gave up trying to buy a fridge from this place, why does the price keep fluctuating everyday?
[SiliconeFries] They use the FOMO business model with timed deals and bundles
[Minimum-Chips] @godofpizza - now's the time to pull the trigger.
[Asryael] That's why I made the website I linked in another comment here, to track their prices.
[Asryael] All time low, but also seems to go there fairly often - https://supa.watch/item/SC-CO-AKEFR40-AKECOV40
[constipated] Fridge, cover and AC adapter have been this low before.
https://supa.watch/item/SC-CO-AKEFR40-AKECOV40-12VAC
